prompt: Can you write me an email telling my boss that I will be out because I am going on a vacation that was planned months ago?
response:
Certainly! Here's a professional and courteous email you can send to your boss:

---

Subject: Vacation Planned Months Ago - [Your Name]

Dear [Boss's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you that I will be taking a planned vacation from [Start Date] to [End Date]. This vacation was scheduled months ago and has been coordinated with my personal commitments.

During my absence, I will ensure that all my ongoing projects and responsibilities are up to date and handed over to a colleague who will be available to assist in my absence. I have also set up an out-of-office auto-reply to manage any urgent communications.

If there are any critical issues that require my attention during this period, please do not hesitate to contact [Colleague's Name] or [Colleague's Contact Information], who will be able to assist until I return.

Thank you for your understanding. I look forward to returning refreshed and ready to continue our work on [mention any specific projects or tasks if relevant].

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
[Your Contact Information]

---

Feel free to adjust the details to better fit your situation and relationship with your boss.
